system.description: Spend 3 Hope when an adversary within Far range moves, attacks, or targets you or an ally to use the terrain against them. They must make a Reaction Roll (14). On a failure, they become temporarily Vulnerable or temporarily Restrained and mark 1 Stress. If they are operating a vehicle, you may instead make that vehicle become Damaged. On a success, they mark 1 Stress.
